subject: Geocoding a list of locations using loop

messages.author: b530af60787d62ad
messages.subject: Geocoding a list of locations using loop
parts:
Hi,

I am a bit of a beginner getting to grips with R.

I'm trying to geocode a list of descriptive locations and return coordinates to plot on GIS. I have a dataframe of Twitter users and isolated the locations column (column 12) giving a list of locations. Then ran a loop:

for (i in data.frame[[12]]){geocode(i)

When running the loop none of the requests were returned even though they worked fine when testing them out manually. The location shows up as a search term in the URL returned from Google API but the coordinates are not listed.

Could this be something to do with the way R treats the independent variable "i", and is there a way for it to read the text strings as a whole?

Please see image attached

Thanks!
John

messages.subject: Re: Geocoding a list of locations using loop
parts:
I've never used these functions in ggmap, but I don't understand why you need to use a for() loop. 

You can feed geocode a vector and it's output is a dataframe, which you should be able to cbind() back to your original dataframe for plotting.

geocode(c("London", "Los Angeles, CA"))

You need to assign the result of geocode to something, e.g.,

geocodes <- vector(length=ncol(data.frame))
names(geocodes) <- data.frame[[12]]
